dedupe_keys.name: hong kong tree register and open tree data development bureau

description: The Tree Register of the Greening, Landscape and Tree Management Section of the Hong Kong Development Bureau is an online map of Old and Valuable Trees, stonewall trees and other trees under monitoring, searchable by district, department, tree species and register numbers. Each tree record gives the department, species, register and departmental numbers, triage colour, height, crown spread, trunk diameter, vigour, location, coordinates, last inspection date and a photo, and the legend marks trees with brown root rot. The map shows counts by managing department, such as 307 trees of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. The bureau also publishes, on DATA.GOV.HK, information on Old and Valuable Trees and stonewall trees through the CSDI Portal API, updated half-yearly, and the number of trees planted in urban and rural areas in about the past ten years as XML, updated annually. Access is free; the Tree Register states all rights reserved, and the open datasets fall under the DATA.GOV.HK terms and conditions. Caveats: the register covers trees under monitoring, not every tree, and part of the page shows a last update date of 2015. Coverage is Hong Kong. It supports analysis of tree failure risk to roads and power lines during typhoons and of urban green infrastructure; related records are the Zurich tree cadastre and the Copenhagen street trees.
